desc: Affordable and practical, the Raygun packs all the essentials into a work-ready folder. Its reverse tanto blade provides a strong tip for piercing and versatile cutting performance. Assisted opening and a flipper make blade access quick and easy. The glass-filled nylon handle features a comfortable shape and stylized texture for grip. At work, in the shop, or on the go, the Raygun is a no-nonsense everyday carry choice.
